context: A boss reviews a manufacturing-team roster
purpose: Teach: 長谷川/戸田/松下/原田/小島/大野/吉川/柴田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 製造部、長谷川部長と戸田課長で、引き続き。
lines.en: Manufacturing — Hasegawa and Toda continue in their current roles.
lines.style: Steady, even cadence. Clear articulation on each name. No warmth, no harshness — the tone of someone distributing information. Brief pause after the department name, then forward momentum.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。松下さん、原田さん、現場主任のままです。
lines.en: Yes. Matsushita and Harada remain as line foremen.
lines.style: Attentive, efficient. Slight nod in the voice on each name — confirming what was heard. No embellishment. The tone of someone following orders and relaying them accurately.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 小島さんと大野さんは、海外生産拠点へ転勤。
lines.en: Kojima and Ono are being transferred to our overseas production facilities.
lines.style: Measured, matter-of-fact. No apology in the delivery — this is business, stated clearly. Slight weight on the verb 'transferred,' as if the decision is final and settled.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 吉川さんが品質管理、柴田さんが調達担当です。
lines.en: Yoshikawa takes over quality control. Shibata handles procurement.
lines.style: Crisp, informative. Light emphasis on each role — delineating responsibility. No elaboration, no pause for reaction. The rhythm of someone moving through a checklist efficiently.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Brief, decisive. Slight rise in energy — moving from listening to action. The tone of someone ready to execute. No hesitation.
